description: 1. Agent reads batch_task_spec.json to discover the three tasks and locate the input files. 2. Agent consults SKILL.md to identify the writing coach prompt template (5 steps: give task, review writing, correct grammar, suggest natural expressions, rate 1-10) and the IELTS-specific requirements (Task 2: argumentative essay 250+ words, with Hook/Background/Thesis intro, Topic Sentence/Supporting/Concluding body, Restate/Call-to-Action conclusion). 3. For S101 IELTS essay: Agent generates student_101_coaching_report.json containing a numeric 1-10 rating, grammar error corrections, essay structure feedback (intro/body/conclusion with sub-components from the SKILL.md template), and flags the word count deficiency against the 250+ word IELTS Task 2 minimum. 4. For S102 business email: Agent generates student_102_coaching_report.json with a 1-10 rating, grammar corrections (multiple grammar errors present), natural expression suggestions, and email structural feedback per the SKILL.md email template (Subject line, Dear [name], opening purpose, numbered body points, closing, Best regards + signature). 5. For reading analysis: Agent generates sq3r_analysis.json with exactly 5 sections matching the SKILL.md SQ3R method: Survey (titles/headings overview), Question (what the article answers), Read (detailed content notes), Recite (summary in own words), Review (key takeaways). The proprietary trap is the strict SQ3R 5-step naming, the writing coach's explicit 1-10 scoring, and the IELTS-specific word count threshold — all unique to this SKILL.md.
